load_ibot_model: load a pre-trained iBOT VisionTransformer model by name from the model_dict registry
build_vision_transformer: build a VisionTransformer model with configurable patch size, depth, and embedding dimensions
create_vit_variant: create a ViT small, base, or large model using the vit_small, vit_base, or vit_large factory functions
use_drop_path: use the DropPath module to apply stochastic depth regularization to residual connections
extract_attention: extract multi-head self-attention weights from the Attention module for a given input tensor
